title: My Dad Blamed My Games for His Dead Car Battery #shorts

cast.dad: a stick-figure father with a round white head, dot eyes, thin black limbs, short brown hair and a blue flannel shirt
cast.girl: a stick-figure girl with a round white head, dot eyes, thin black limbs, two black pigtails and a purple hoodie
cast.car: one small silver four-door sedan car

lines.text: Dad said my games killed his car battery, so what was really draining it?
lines.label: hook
lines.headline: what drained the battery
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, short brown hair and blue flannel shirt, standing in a garage beside {car}, the only car in the picture, with its hood open, holding exactly one car battery, the only battery in the picture in both hands, shocked angry face, morning light

lines.text: Sunday morning, right after Dad's golf trip, his car would not even start.
lines.label: dead car
lines.headline: car won't start
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, short brown hair and blue flannel shirt, sitting in the driver seat of {car}, the only car in the picture, parked in a garage, turning the key, frustrated face, dashboard dark, morning, no golf clubs in the picture

lines.text: He found my controller cable in his car and said I charged it there nightly.
lines.label: the charge
lines.headline: cable in the car
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, short brown hair and blue flannel shirt, standing next to {car}, the only car in the picture, in a garage, holding up exactly one black charging cable in one hand, frowning, mouth open talking

lines.text: The new battery cost a hundred eighty dollars, so he locked my console away.
lines.label: stakes
lines.headline: console locked away
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, short brown hair and blue flannel shirt, inside a garage putting exactly one small flat black game console box into exactly one metal cabinet, stern face, {car}, the only car in the picture, parked behind him, no TV in the picture

lines.text: Two mornings later, with no cable and no console, the car was dead again.
lines.label: worse
lines.headline: dead again
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, short brown hair and blue flannel shirt, standing beside {car}, the only car in the picture, in a garage with the hood up, both hands on his head, mouth open in disbelief, morning

lines.text: Dad said I still sneaked out to his car at night, and took my phone.
lines.label: more blame
lines.headline: phone gone too
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, short brown hair and blue flannel shirt, standing in a hallway holding exactly one phone up high out of reach, frowning, evening light

lines.text: I cried into my pillow, blamed for a car I can't even drive yet.
lines.label: alone
lines.headline: blamed and grounded
lines.image: close-up of {girl}, the only person in the picture, two black pigtails and purple hoodie, lying alone in bed hugging her pillow, a single tear running down her cheek, sad eyes, dim bedroom at night

lines.text: That night I peeked into the garage and saw a faint glow by the trunk.
lines.label: the glow
lines.headline: a glow in the dark
lines.image: {girl} is the only person in the picture, two black pigtails and purple hoodie, peeking around a door into a dark garage at night, eyes wide, {car}, the only car in the picture, parked inside with a soft yellow glow coming from the back of the car

lines.text: In my games, a glow means something's hidden there, so I tiptoed closer.
lines.label: gamer clue
lines.headline: glow means loot
lines.image: {girl} is the only person in the picture, two black pigtails and purple hoodie, tiptoeing across a dark garage floor at night toward the back of {car}, the only car in the picture, one finger on her lips, curious face, soft yellow glow at the back of the car

lines.text: Dad's golf bag kept the trunk from latching, so its light burned all night.
lines.label: the twist
lines.headline: the open trunk
lines.image: {girl} is the only person in the picture, two black pigtails and purple hoodie, standing at the back of {car}, the only car in the picture, in a dark garage at night, lifting the trunk lid slightly, inside the trunk one small light glowing and one brown golf bag, the only golf bag in the picture, with clubs sticking up against the lid, surprised face

lines.text: I showed Dad the glowing trunk, he moved his clubs, and the car started.
lines.label: proof
lines.headline: the car starts
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, short brown hair and blue flannel shirt, sitting in the driver seat of {car}, the only car in the picture, in a garage, dashboard lights on, big relieved smile, exactly one brown golf bag, the only golf bag in the picture, leaning against the garage wall, morning

lines.text: Console back, but Dad still blames my cable, and I blame his golf bag.
lines.label: the ending
lines.headline: console back
